backlogged.summary: processTable() uses spawnSync('ps') with a 5 s timeout, which blocks the event loop of a parallel run during an abort or timeout. It is only a brief stall in the normal case.
killDescendants reads the process table once, then kills. A detached grandchild forked between the ps read and the kill escapes. This is a narrow race and the contract does not cover it.

The AC-1 and AC-2 tests use fake build, verify and evaluate functions instead of the CLI path `harness run --resume --parallel N`. The CLI wiring of --parallel for resume is therefore only covered indirectly.
